headline: Qazax: Regional centre with extensive healthcare and education coverage

tags.reason: Family friendly due to 7.65 schools per 10,000 residents compared to the national median of 4.14.
Infrastructure shows a paved road share of 2.7% against the national median of 4.35%.

summary: Qazax has a population of 96,700 and a density of 138 inhabitants per square kilometre. The healthcare index is 89 with 2.79 hospitals per 10,000 residents, exceeding the national median of 0.75. The comfort index is 86 supported by 10.75 groceries per 10,000 residents, while the infrastructure index is 28. The area features 7.65 schools per 10,000 residents and a PM2.5 air quality level of 11.9.
